moodys.citation_text: Moody's press release title 'Moody's revises Catholic Medical Centers (NH) outlook to negative; affirms Baa3' confirms Baa3 was the rating prior to the September 2023 outlook revision and through 2022-12-31. The InDepthNH and Patch coverage references 'August 22, 2023 downgrade from Baa3 negative to Ba1 negative' — meaning the path was Baa3 stable -> Baa3 negative (Sept 27 2023) -> Ba1 negative (Aug 2023 reporting describes the action timing). The chronology in the trade press appears to be: Sept 27 2023 outlook revision (Baa3 affirmed); then a subsequent August 2024 downgrade to Ba1. Verified Baa3/Stable on 2022-12-31.

sp.citation_text: Universe v2 lists S&P null for CMC. Healthcare Dive reporting confirms 'credit ratings agencies S&P Global Ratings and Moody's Ratings downgraded CMC during the summer of 2024' but the S&P starting rating not extracted.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Affirmed Baa3; outlook revised to negative from stable
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Operating losses driven by heavy reliance on contract labor, elevated wages, inflationary pressures.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's press release title 'Moody's revises Catholic Medical Centers (NH) outlook to negative; affirms Baa3'.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Downgraded to Ba1 from Baa3; outlook negative (fallen-angel / crossed into speculative grade)
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Weak operating performance, cash declines, reduced financial flexibility; 'liquidity will remain narrow to its bank debt covenant given ongoing cashflow losses'.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: InDepthNH/Patch: 'In August, Moody's Investors Service downgraded the hospital's bond rating to Ba1 negative — or junk bond status — reporting that its weak operating performance has driven cash declines and reduced financial flexibility.' The Beckers chronology and Healthcare Dive both reference a 2024 summer downgrade by both Moody's and S&P.
rating_actions_in_window._warning: Date ambiguity: trade press references both 'August 2023' and 'summer 2024' for what may be the same fallen-angel downgrade to Ba1. Most likely interpretation: Moody's revised outlook negative Sept 2023; downgraded Baa3 -> Ba1 in summer 2024.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: S&P downgraded CMC during summer 2024; warned further downgrade possible absent HCA close
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Same drivers as Moody's; HCA acquisition uncertainty.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Healthcare Dive: 'Credit ratings agencies S&P Global Ratings and Moody's Ratings downgraded CMC during the summer of 2024, and S&P warned a further downgrade was possible if CMC's deal with HCA did not close.'

moodys.citation_text: Ba1/Negative carried into early 2025; HCA acquisition closed February 1, 2025 — at which point CMC ceased to be a standalone obligor and rolled into HCA's consolidated rated entity.

sp.citation_text: S&P downgraded summer 2024 to unidentified notch with negative outlook; rating subsumed into HCA post-Feb 1 2025 close.

outcome_class_rationale: Moody's downgraded Baa3 -> Ba1 (one notch but also fallen-angel into speculative grade) summer 2024 plus S&P downgrade summer 2024; on top of Sept 2023 outlook revisions. This is a fallen-angel event — classification = DOWNGRADE at minimum, MULTI_DOWNGRADE if S&P's exact magnitude (assumed parallel notch) is ≥1 notch. HCA acquisition closed Feb 1, 2025 within the window; CMC effectively ceased as standalone credit. The trajectory through window end is consistent with classification 'MULTI_DOWNGRADE' (BBB- -> BB+ tier with negative outlook through close).
